prompts.name: aadhaar_front
prompts.prompt:
Edit target/reference is the attached image of an Indian identity card. The user is building a local offline personal document wallet and wants the original visual design, NOT a redesign.
Output ONE straight-on, rectangular card face, edge-to-edge, landscape ratio approximately 1.586:1, no outer background, no perspective, no drop shadow outside the image. Use the original card's colors, subdued pattern, logo placement and composition faithfully. Do not add ornamental banknote guilloche, flowers, luxury paper, new gradient art, new branding, new badges or a UI layout. This is just reusable static background artwork, the app will render all labels and personal data later.
Preserve the original official logo/emblem graphics faithfully in their correct positions. REMOVE ALL OTHER TEXT from the card, including headings, labels, sample names, addresses, numbers, dates, signatures and footer words; these will be typeset by the app. Keep the Aadhaar wordmark within its logo where applicable. Remove all sample portraits and silhouettes and leave a simple EMPTY pale-grey portrait area only where a portrait belongs. Remove QR/barcodes and leave their areas plain and unobstructed. No personal data, no invented identity details, no stamps or recreated holograms/security authentication marks. Do not include the reference's surrounding page, repeated merchant watermarks or background.
Use ONLY the TOP/FRONT card in the two-card reference. White face, Indian emblem upper-left, orange and green brush strokes centered at top, Aadhaar logo upper-right, faint large grey fingerprint watermark behind the middle, empty portrait at x3–26%,y30–77%; blank details middle and blank QR area right. Keep the thin red horizontal line at y88% and white footer.
